label: Offline fixture index for the GEO adapter
note: INVENTED RECORDS. Every accession below begins with SYNTHETIC-GSE because none of them is a real GEO accession, and presenting an invented accession as a real one would be fabricating a citation. The records exist to exercise the search adapter's scoring, normalisation and candidate contract offline. A live GEO search returns real accessions and is gated behind an explicit network permission.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: M-CSF dose response in human iPSC-derived macrophage differentiation
records.summary: Invented record. Bulk expression across three M-CSF concentrations during myeloid commitment, with CD14 and MRC1 among the reported markers.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: BACH2 knockout in activated primary human T cells
records.summary: Invented record. Transcriptional profile of BACH2 knockout versus wild type after anti-CD3/CD28 activation, exhaustion and memory programmes reported.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: single-cell atlas of inflammatory versus homeostatic macrophages
records.summary: Invented record. Single-cell transcriptomes contrasting inflammatory and homeostatic macrophage states. Declarable today; BioSense has no single-cell reader until Phase 2.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: shear stress and apoptosis signatures in stirred-tank iPSC culture
records.summary: Invented record. Stress and apoptosis programmes across agitation rates in suspension culture, relevant to agitation_rpm as a process parameter.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: CD14 and CD16 population frequencies during myeloid differentiation
records.summary: Invented record. Gated population frequencies over the harvest window, reported as percentages per sample.

records.title: SYNTHETIC: BACH2 ChIP-seq in human CD8 T cells
records.summary: Invented record. Transcription factor occupancy. Declarable today; BioSense has no peak tooling until Phase 2.
